values.note: 40 full-hookup RV sites (7 with 50-amp, 33 with 30-amp), some premium lake-view; plus 5 deluxe tent sites and 1 large tent site. Mooring posts first-come.
Campers may pay a resort fee ($5 per person per day) for the resort's indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs and gym; a boardwalk over the water connects the campground to the resort.

facilities.source: https://www.stonewallresort.com/roanoke-west-virginia-accommodations/campgrounds/ ('Complimentary High Speed Wireless Internet', 'For just $5 per person, per day for registered campground guests'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked by Stonewall Resort, not on the WV State Parks booking site: 'Reservations may be made by phone or in person. To reserve a campsite, please call 304-269-8889 or visit our location at the Entrance Gate. There are no online reservation options.' Bookable for start dates up to 12 complete months ahead, opening on the 1st of each month. Holiday minimum 5 nights. 50% deposit, forfeited on cancellation; full stay charged inside 30 days. Specific sites not guaranteed.

summary: Fees confirmed as recorded (2026 table, $70 base, weekend +$4, premium lake view +$6; tax and a $2 park enhancement fee extra). Added year-round season, 50-amp full hookups on all 40 RV sites, wifi. Booking overridden: phone/in person only with Stonewall Resort, 12-month window, 5-night holiday minimum (the inherited state:WV online booking site and 2-night weekend minimum do not apply). flags: Wrong policy row: Briar Point is run and booked by Stonewall Resort (stonewallresort.com, phone 304-269-8889, 'There are no online reservation options'), not through WV State Parks' book.wvstateparks.com, and its rules differ (12-month window, 5-night holiday minimum, no weekend minimum stated, 50% deposit forfeited on any cancellation). The entry's own booking values now override reservable/platform/url/min_stay, but the state:WV 14-night max_stay_nights and the agency booking note still inherit; consider policy_ref 'none' for this entry. Ownership 'state' is defensible (WV State Parks lists it as Stonewall Resort State Park); the resort operator is a concessioner on the state park, and neither page mentions the Corps of Engineers.
Entry has no phone. The campground's reservation line is 304-269-8889 (resort main 304-269-7400).
Optional resort fee $5 per person per day buys pool/hot tub/gym access; a mandatory $2 park enhancement fee is added to every reservation (per reservation, not per night).
